text_block_list.text:
One day, I was on my way with Royce and Royce
to observe an academic conference on the latest training methods.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Roughly two hours one way. I'll make sure to spend this time with maximum cost and time efficiency!"
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll spend the time organizing paperwork too.
Maybe I'll spend the time organizing paperwork too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Taishin-san's arm-swing rhythm has changed—no change in lap time yet. I'll keep a close eye on her movements.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Ticket's been taking more morning baths lately.
Could she be doing secret early-morning training...? Better make a note of that, too.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you finish all the work on your plate?
I've just finished the tasks I had planned for today as well.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll just play it safe and sleep on the way back...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Well, while that is meaningful
in its own way—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“...Let's go for now, shall we?
Maybe we'll find some hints at the conference!”

text_block_list.name: Speaker A
text_block_list.text:
Training efficiency varies depending on how well
the Trainer and the Umamusume can communicate.
Please look at the materials at hand.

text_block_list.name: Speaker A
text_block_list.text:
I had a certain pair play catch
before training.

text_block_list.name: Speaker A
text_block_list.text:
"Throwing the ball where it's easy for the other person to catch.
As that ability improved, the effectiveness of the training increased right alongside it."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hmm... I see.

text_block_list.name: Speaker B
text_block_list.text:
In Europe, optimizing recovery is gaining attention.
It's the concept of incorporating "rest" into training rather than just cooldowns.

text_block_list.name: Speaker B
text_block_list.text:
What is crucial here is the reduction of information.
We have found that recovery improves
by "blocking out" external stimuli.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

I review today's materials
while waiting for the Shinkansen home.
choice_data_list: Maybe I'll read through this carefully on the way back...
Maybe I'll read through this carefully on the way back...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe.
If we're doing this, shouldn't we put it into "practice"?
Indeed, if it's recovery training that blocks out sensory stimuli, it seems doable even on the bullet train. However—
choice_data_list: You can't play catch here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"That's with a Royce-chan twist, of course♪
And so――"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Plan A! Playing emotional catch, the 'Telepathic Connection Challenge' for mutual understanding!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Plan B! Taken straight from the lectures, it's 'Sensory Deprivation Recovery Training'!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now then, which one are you interested in?
choice_data_list: I'm tired, so let's do some recovery training.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple.
You just write down the answer to the other person's
gesture charade in your notebook.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
However, you only get one gesture!
If you keep continuing the question until you get it right, it won't streamline communication at all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Now, let's give it our all!
In the quiet car—a unique tension hung in the air around these seats alone...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Here goes: "Telepathic Connection Challenge"—

Nothing's changed—no, that can't be.
There must be some small change.

—She usually acts with strict time-efficiency in mind.
Not wasting a single moment.
Yes, even at this very moment—

"Something that can be fully expressed through gestures.
In that case, choosing something I observe closely
on a regular basis would be best."
In that case—this is it!

She swiped across her tablet,
occasionally giving her glasses a slight nudge up her nose.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

The answer Royce and Royce wrote in her notebook
was—"Me, analyzing data♡"

She seems happy to have gotten it right.
Even without words, it's radiating through her whole body!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
choice_data_list: (So that means upping the difficulty next time, huh!)
(So that means upping the difficulty next time, huh!)

text_block_list.text: After that, they continued to quiz each other, and their bond grew even stronger!

The answer Royce and Royce wrote in her notebook
was—"DJ!!"

Unfortunately, that is incorrect.
Reluctantly, I made a big 'X' with my arms.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Guh! To think you were imitating me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"So before getting to know you,
I need to know myself first, huh...!
That's quite an insightful perspective in its own right."

Unfortunately, it ended in failure,
but a brand-new insight was gained from it...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I might like a little sleep too.
However, this is strictly training.
I will not let it become just an ordinary nap.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Instead of our usual walk home,
let's have some meaningful sleep!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Alright.
Once I put on the mask and earplugs, I'll be all set.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By shutting out environmental influences as much as possible,
you can focus entirely on your own recovery.
Didn't they say so at the academic conference too?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With what I've got on hand right now,
this is the best way to shut out the environment.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Here, you should wear it too—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...... Looking good.
In all kinds of ways!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Just trust me on this.
Good night!"

The stares from around felt a bit uncomfortable at first,
but before long, I stopped caring.
Before I knew it, I fell fast asleep and got plenty of rest!
